Select: mol.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary mol, compound_records cr, compound_structures cs. Join: mol.molregno = cr.molregno, mol.molregno = cs.molregno, cr.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126796', cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort: mol.chembl_id ASC, cr.compound_name ASC, cs.canonical_smiles ASC. Deduplication: Distinct rows.
